businesses.sourceAndScopeNotes: Owner terms linked in the form concern pickup/service performance and ordinary copyright notices, with no explicit fact/tariff commercial-use prohibition observed. No real booking, phone call or form submission. Site footer/landing hours differ, so no hours are imported.
